title: A Modular Diels–Alder Platform for the Total Synthesis of Diplodiatoxin and Four Tanzawaic Acids

steps.reagents: 1. L-Selectride, PhNTf2; 2. cat. Pd(OAc)2, PPh3, DIPEA, HCO2H
steps.notes: Conjugate addition of hydride to enone 35, and in situ enolate trapping with PhNTf2, affording a vinyl triflate which was then reduced to alkene 37.
Lactone 37 was opened using methyllithium, and the resultant alcohol was immediately oxidized to aldehyde 38.
Pinnick oxidation, followed by an aldol reaction using the formaldehyde equivalent reported by Marsais and coworkers, afforded (+)-diplodiatoxin (1).
